task: Deepen (flagship 10) open-tennis-robots: rerun the lift jam sweep on the distributed belt

goal: Check the lift's jam cutoff on a belt modelled with its mass where it rides (stuck mode 34-41 Hz, not the lumped 38).
notes: Added Feeder.lift_belt_chain (shared by lift_belt_axial_modes, identical modes) and Plant(chain=) in tests/lift_jam_sweep.py, --chain report (11m57s).
